title: AI Engineer
description: Design, build, and deploy scalable AI/ML systems and LLM-powered applications — RAG systems, AI agents, and multi-agent workflows — using Python, Node.js, and TypeScript. 4–7 years of software engineering experience. Remote/Hybrid, based in Pune.
about: We are building next-generation AI-powered commerce infrastructure and intelligent platforms that help businesses become AI-agent ready. Our products combine LLMs, data pipelines, automation systems, agentic workflows, and scalable cloud infrastructure to solve real-world commerce and enterprise problems.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI/ML systems, intelligent automation pipelines, and production-grade AI services.
Architect and optimize LLM-powered applications, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, AI agents, multi-agent workflows, and orchestration frameworks.
Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python, Node.js, and TypeScript to support AI-driven applications.
Integrate and manage enterprise AI models and platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, Grok, Llama, and vector database technologies.
Build and maintain data pipelines, embedding workflows, semantic search capabilities, recommendation engines, and knowledge retrieval systems.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and design teams to deliver scalable AI-first products and features.
